fact: Le Temps d'une paix begins on Radio-Canada. It will run until 1986.
Lance et compte premieres. The hockey drama becomes a Québec classic.
Les Filles de Caleb draws more than 3 million viewers on Radio-Canada.
La Petite Vie premieres. Some episodes top 4 million viewers.
Un gars, une fille premieres. Its format is later adapted around the world.
Star Académie launches on TVA and becomes a ratings phenomenon.
Netflix launches in Canada. Streaming starts to change how Québec watches TV.
Vidéotron launches Club illico, a made-in-Québec streaming service.
District 31 premieres. It airs four nights a week until 2022.
COVID-19 halts many TV shoots, and Quebecers watch more TV at home.
